newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech executive vice president resigns.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech executive vice president resigns.

text.p: Ameritech Corp said Monday Andrew Patti, executive vice president, has resigned for personal, family-related reasons.

Ameritech also said it realigned some responsibilities and reporting relationships, effective immediately. Barry Allen was appointed executive vice president of the Consumer and Business Services Sector succeeding Patti.
Thomas Richards succeeds Allen and was promoted to executive vice president of the Communications and Information Products Sector.
Wharton "Zie" Rivers Jr. was promoted to president of Network Services succeeding Richards.
Ameritech provides communications services, including local and long distance telephone, cellular, paging, security monitoring, cable TV, electronic commerce, and on-line services.
